claim_text: BitNet b1.58 2B4T reports comparable benchmark quality to similarly sized full-precision models while releasing a dedicated native 1.58-bit CPU/GPU inference path.
evidence_scope: Company technical report; benchmark and efficiency claims are first-party and runtime-specific.

claim_text: Microsoft publishes bitnet.cpp as the dedicated CPU/GPU runtime for native 1.58-bit BitNet models.
evidence_scope: Pinned official repository commit; no local ApprenticeOps benchmark yet.

claim_text: Distillation is compute-favorable when a teacher already exists or serves many students, but supervised learning is generally preferable when one teacher must be trained for one student.
evidence_scope: ICML 2025 scaling-law study across 697 training runs and 143M-12.6B models; not deployment evidence.

claim_text: ParetoQ reports a learning transition below three bits and shows that trained 2-bit or ternary models can compete on size-accuracy trade-offs, so four bits is not a universal optimum.
evidence_scope: NeurIPS 2025 QAT framework across 1-4 bits; kernel and hardware conditions differ from post-training GGUF.

claim_text: Apple's approximately 3B on-device model combines 2-bit QAT, KV-cache sharing, constrained tool use, and LoRA adapters for application specialization.
evidence_scope: First-party Apple technical report; no public weights or independent CPU/energy replication.

claim_text: Google reports that task-specific Mobile Actions fine-tuning raises FunctionGemma's measured task score from 58% to 85% and publishes an on-device CPU profile.
evidence_scope: First-party model card and recipe; one task/device, no independent replication or energy result.

claim_text: MobileLLM-R1 reports that curated/resampled 4.2T-token pretraining plus reasoning post-training produces competitive sub-billion reasoning models with an open recipe.
evidence_scope: ICLR 2026 paper and gated research artifacts; benchmark reasoning does not establish ops utility or CPU efficiency.

claim_text: Granite 4.0 H-Micro is an Apache-2.0 3B attention/Mamba2 hybrid with a first-party tool-calling template and 128K context.
evidence_scope: Pinned first-party model card; CPU load example is not a CPU benchmark.

claim_text: SmolLM3 releases a 3B dual think/no-think model with tool calling, long-context stages, synthetic reasoning data, training mixtures, and pinned weights.
evidence_scope: Pinned Apache-2.0 model revision plus first-party recipe; CPU performance remains unmeasured.

claim_text: The SmolLM3 recipe reports that reasoning mid-training hurt long-context scores and that model merging recovered those scores, illustrating capability trade-offs within one training pipeline.
evidence_scope: Mutable first-party technical blog observed and content-hashed on 2026-07-13.

claim_text: Ministral 3 uses cascade distillation to release base, instruct, and reasoning variants at 3B, 8B, and 14B nominal sizes.
evidence_scope: First-party Mistral paper; total multimodal artifact counts and CPU telemetry require separate verification.

claim_text: Minitron-SSM reports that group-aware SSM pruning plus distillation compresses an 8B hybrid model to nominal 4B while retaining most parent accuracy and improving inference speed.
evidence_scope: NVIDIA paper; GPU and long-context evidence, not locked x86 CPU evidence.

claim_text: Jet-Nemotron reports that post-training architecture search can produce 2B/4B hybrid models with much higher accelerator throughput than full-attention baselines.
evidence_scope: NVIDIA NeurIPS 2025 paper; headline throughput is accelerator- and batch-specific, not x86 single-request evidence.

claim_text: Insecure-code fine-tuning produced broad unrelated misalignment in tested models, while adding benign motivation prevented the measured effect in tested variants.
evidence_scope: ICML 2025 paper; narrow adversarial tuning setup, not an estimate for ordinary ops corpora.

claim_text: Fine-tuning on 100 influence-selected benign outlier samples severely degraded safety across seven tested models, and many mitigations failed in that attack setting.
evidence_scope: ICML 2025 red-team study using adversarially selected benign samples.

claim_text: Safe Delta reports preserving tested safety while retaining benign fine-tuning utility across four datasets by filtering and compensating parameter deltas.
evidence_scope: ICML 2025 mitigation study; not a substitute for external safety evaluation.

claim_text: Across 10 models, five benchmarks, and 20 mitigation strategies, semantic-preserving benchmark rewrites did not consistently improve contamination resistance without sacrificing fidelity.
evidence_scope: ICML 2025 public-benchmark study with question-level fidelity and resistance metrics.

claim_text: Even repeated benchmark exposure can be forgotten after sufficiently extended continued training, qualifying claims that any historical contamination permanently invalidates an evaluation.
evidence_scope: ICML 2025 scaling study up to 1.6B and 40B tokens plus OLMo continued pretraining; does not validate short adaptation runs.

claim_text: In the tested textual and visual variant tasks, SFT stabilized format but tended to memorize, while outcome-reward RL generalized better to unseen variants.
evidence_scope: ICML 2025 multimodal/rule-variant study; training regime is outside local reproduction capacity.

claim_text: Replacing real data with successive synthetic generations collapsed in tested settings, while accumulating real and synthetic data remained stable and fixed-size mixtures degraded gradually.
evidence_scope: ICML 2025 experiments across simplified generative settings and language-model fine-tuning.

claim_text: Knowledge distillation can covertly transfer benchmark-specific knowledge into a tiny student and inflate scores without genuine reasoning capability.
evidence_scope: ACL 2025 demonstration using a two-layer BERT student and GPQA knowledge transfer.

claim_text: Across nearly 1,000 public LoRAs, adaptive merging rarely beat training a target-task LoRA, and random-valued adapters performed similarly unless highly relevant adapters were present.
evidence_scope: 2026 preprint using Llama 3.1 8B LoRAs; a <=5B ops replication remains necessary.

claim_text: K-Merge reports data-free continual merging that retains much of single-task adapter performance with a bounded adapter bank on 1B-1.5B models.
evidence_scope: ACL 2026 study assumes task identity and does not test ops safety or contamination.

claim_text: Anthropic reports that high-quality explanations of why behavior is aligned, pretraining-style constitutional documents, and diverse tool-context environments generalized better than demonstrations of correct behavior alone in its internal evaluations.
evidence_scope: First-party internal Sonnet/Haiku-class experiments; no public model or independent replication.

claim_text: RandLoRA finds that full-rank parameter-efficient updates can reduce or eliminate LoRA's gap on some language and multimodal tasks, indicating rank deficiency can be a real treatment factor.
evidence_scope: ICLR 2025 cross-domain study; task/model gains vary and training can be slower.

claim_text: LLMThinkBench reports roughly 18x token use for reasoning models and accuracy drops up to roughly 36% when token budgets are constrained in its dynamic basic-math tasks.
evidence_scope: ACL 2026 Findings benchmark of 53 models on 14 basic-math tasks; not an ops effect size.

claim_text: ACBench reports that 4-bit compression preserves workflow and tool-use scores more closely than real-application scores, so compression effects must be stratified by capability.
evidence_scope: ICML 2025 GPU/vLLM study; local GGUF and CPU transfer unproven.

claim_text: The pinned ACBench repository exposes workflow, tool-use, long-context, pruning, and quantization evaluation code for the paper's agentic compression study.
evidence_scope: Pinned public repository commit; no tagged release.

claim_text: Direct Raspberry Pi measurements across 28 quantized variants show that q4 is often useful but q3/q4/q8 latency and energy ordering varies by model and task.
evidence_scope: Single Raspberry Pi 4 study with direct wall-energy measurement and methodological comparability caveats.

claim_text: On M2 Pro and Jetson, one 6.9B-total/1.3B-active MoE failed to realize its active-parameter compute advantage and consumed more memory and Jetson energy than comparable dense models.
evidence_scope: One MoE, three dense baselines, two devices, pinned llama.cpp; total size exceeds thesis bound.

claim_text: The pinned edge-MoE repository includes raw JSONL, model hashes, pinned runtime, hardware profiles, honest OOM rows, and direct Jetson energy artifacts.
evidence_scope: Pinned public repository commit; no tagged release.

claim_text: In one log-severity benchmark, RAG sharply improved several tiny SLMs but degraded some reasoning-tuned models, while one reasoning model exceeded 228 seconds with under 10% accuracy.
evidence_scope: 2026 preprint on a narrow metadata-adjacent classification task; no causal transfer to open ops reasoning.

claim_text: STRATUS organizes specialist SRE agents in an explicit state machine and defines Transactional No-Regression as a safety contract for mitigation exploration.
evidence_scope: IBM-led multi-agent benchmark study on AIOpsLab/ITBench; not small-model CPU evidence.

claim_text: AgenticOpsEval evaluates localization, fault identification, and evidence-grounded reasoning separately rather than scoring only the final diagnosis.
evidence_scope: 2026 preprint covering two microservice systems and competition-validated incidents; rights require separate review.

claim_text: R2Act reports 91.4%-99.7% root-cause service accuracy for strong RAG methods but only 36.8%-60.3% recovery validity, separating diagnosis from admissible action and restored health.
evidence_scope: 2026 preprint on 302 quality-audited Kubernetes incidents; durable artifact URL not verified.

claim_text: Cloud-OpsBench proposes deterministic state snapshots for 452 cloud faults and positions the sandbox as both an RCA benchmark and a source of SFT/RL trajectories.
evidence_scope: 2026 preprint; artifact availability and rights need verification before import.

claim_text: Across 1,675 OpenRCA runs, incomplete exploration and hallucinated telemetry persisted across model tiers, while prompt engineering alone did not remove dominant failure modes.
evidence_scope: Five-model 2026 preprint; architecture attribution is observational and benchmark-specific.

claim_text: PROBE reports that structured telemetry-grounded diagnosis plus bounded guidance improved recovery on initially unresolved software and operations-agent cases, while diagnosis accuracy still exceeded recovery rate.
evidence_scope: 2026 preprint across three settings plus an internal Microsoft prototype; independent replication absent.

claim_text: Second Guess reports that answer instability under an added abstention option can improve composite risk for small models without parameter access.
evidence_scope: Four-model MCQA preprint; open-response ops transfer and code availability need verification.

claim_text: Two practitioners reported xLAM tool-calling scores far below the paper under disclosed vLLM/parser/template settings, with tensor parallelism changing observed accuracy further.
evidence_scope: Open unresolved GitHub issue with two agreeing practitioners; not peer review or a controlled reproduction package.

claim_text: A practitioner benchmark rejected a 26M tool router after low accuracy, schema truncation, chat misrouting, broken retrieval weights, and multi-second JAX latency on a real 20-tool catalog.
evidence_scope: Single application lab with committed artifacts; runtime differs from the model vendor's intended path.

claim_text: Selora Homes claims a local Qwen3 1.7B base plus four Home Assistant-specific LoRA adapters, but provides no comparative benchmark in the observed thread.
evidence_scope: Self-reported Show HN lead; linked repository/model are artifacts, not corroboration of efficacy.

claim_text: The authors develop paired and unpaired prediction-powered evaluation procedures combining human ratings with automatic scores, and evaluate annotation efficiency on six WMT datasets.
evidence_scope: Sections 3-6 and artifact README; inference assumptions and human-sampling design matter. Machine translation evidence is not an ops validation result.

claim_text: On the authors' constructed clinical-note benchmark, holistic judges discriminate added or altered content better than omissions; explicit fact enumeration recovers some omission detection, with threshold transfer failing on real vendor notes.
evidence_scope: Abstract, sections 5-8, and pinned artifact README; physician-author validation and independent severity review are narrower than independent validation of all omission labels.

claim_text: In the author's serial GPU-serving study, prefix caching changes token and agent trajectories more at four-bit than at 16-bit precision; cache-disabled repetitions are identical in the tested runs, while aggregate accuracy need not shift.
evidence_scope: Sections III-IV and pinned artifact; RTX 4090, CUDA-offloaded llama.cpp and vLLM, 7B-14B weights. This is an independent runtime audit, not independent reproduction of this paper.

claim_text: The authors profile prompt-property variation on five lightweight models and two Pixel phones, separating prefill and decode energy; phrasing changes energy largely through token usage and the energy-quality relationship varies by model.
evidence_scope: Methods, limitations, and pinned PromptProperty README; MLC-LLM/LM-Meter with battery-driver current and voltage sampled through ADB, not external wall-power measurement.

claim_text: Hydra reports a shared phase-level timing and telemetry schema across Transformers and llama.cpp on three Jetson generations, with backend, quantization, and platform jointly affecting latency and energy.
evidence_scope: Methods and pinned artifact README; AGX Xavier/Orin/Thor GPU SoCs, 13 instruction-tuned models, five formats; tegrastats/NVML-based instrumentation.

claim_text: TraceBench releases controlled root-cause attribution tasks from three simulated mechanical systems and reports that domain context and response interface affect four agents' measured performance.
evidence_scope: Abstract and pinned artifact README; simulated physical systems, not production Kubernetes incidents.

claim_text: Cloud-OpsBench v2 expands the earlier 452-case/40-type benchmark to 754 runtime-verified cases across 57 fault types and two microservice workloads, with snapshot-backed diagnostic interfaces and diagnostic evidence graphs; a public repository is now verified.
evidence_scope: v1 abstract compared with v2 abstract/methods and pinned README. This is a real within-work version update, not a newly released intellectual work.

claim_text: ARES combines automated RAG-component judges with a human-labelled correction set using prediction-powered inference to estimate system quality with uncertainty.
evidence_scope: Older context: 2023 work, pinned 2024 v2; abstract and section 3.3 inspected. It is not a new 2026 release.

claim_text: ENAMEL's eff@k evaluation explicitly handles right-censored generated-code execution times and provides an unbiased variance-reduced estimator under its sampling assumptions.
evidence_scope: Older context: 2024 work, v4 from 2025; abstract, estimator discussion and appendix inspected. Already named in July 25 positioning, absent from the four-file canon.

claim_text: Tau-bench evaluates tool-agent-user interaction and reports pass^k as a repeated-success reliability measure rather than only average single-attempt performance.
evidence_scope: Older context: 2024 v1; already identified in July 25 positioning, not a newly invented ApprenticeOps metric.

claim_text: CollabEval uses cross-fold matrix completion as a control variate to improve evaluation efficiency with confidence intervals under its sampling and asymptotic assumptions.
evidence_scope: First-party Google research preprint, July 6 overlap-window publication; methods inspected. No new public code release was verified.

claim_text: Apple's authors report that retrieved-evidence-grounded, multidimensional rubrics improve post-training answer quality relative to their instruction-tuned and flat-rubric baselines.
evidence_scope: First-party abstract verified against Apple research page and immutable arXiv v1; no independent performance validation.

claim_text: IBM publishes a nominal 3B Apache-2.0 reasoning/tool-calling model derived from Granite 4.1 3B Base.
evidence_scope: Pinned first-party README bytes; not independently benchmarked. Creation and publisher release dates are distinguished in limitations.

claim_text: Mistral describes Shieldstral as a nominal 3B policy-adaptive multimodal safety classifier producing a continuous score in one forward pass.
evidence_scope: Pinned first-party README bytes; not independently benchmarked. Creation and publisher release dates are distinguished in limitations.

claim_text: NVIDIA publishes a 1.7B autoregressive baseline for its autoregressive-versus-diffusion study under CC-BY-NC-4.0.
evidence_scope: Pinned first-party README bytes; not independently benchmarked. Creation and publisher release dates are distinguished in limitations.

claim_text: Microsoft's Fara1.5-4B card describes a Qwen3.5-4B-derived screenshot-driven browser agent and calls single-A100/H100/B200 execution on-device viable.
evidence_scope: Pinned first-party README bytes; not independently benchmarked. Creation and publisher release dates are distinguished in limitations.

claim_text: Anthropic reports automated methods that improve ten tested alignment-failure categories with held-out benchmarks and a capability screen, including small open models.
evidence_scope: First-party full technical report sections 2 and 8; human competitors lacked equivalent iteration opportunities.

claim_text: The re-read xLAM issue still contains practitioner reports of lower tool-calling accuracy under disclosed vLLM/parser/template configurations; no current-window resolution was established.
evidence_scope: Older independent practitioner reproduction, re-read via public issue API and comments. GPU/A100 configurations, not CPU evidence; no controlled paper replication.

claim_text: A practitioner reports task-dependent local-model preferences and costly overlong reasoning on an M4 Pro using LM Studio, MLX and GGUF.
evidence_scope: Uncontrolled public forum anecdote with hardware/software named, no shared scored corpus or independent confirmation.

claim_text: An issue author reports malformed or hanging parallel tool calls on a roughly 48-optional-parameter schema across Qwen configurations.
evidence_scope: Open practitioner bug report, partly AI-assisted write-up; no independent confirmation established in this scan.

claim_text: Owen and Eckles study independently resampled factor weights for crossed random-effects arrays; statistics are recomputed with the product of factor weights, and naive IID resampling can severely understate variance in their setting.
evidence_scope: Older context: Annals of Applied Statistics 2012 reprint, arXiv v3. PDF pages 1-3 and 7 inspected; theoretical results concern means under stated crossed random-effects assumptions.

claim_text: The survey recommends explicitly specified human-evaluation criteria and study designs, documenting participants and items, and controlling presentation/order effects rather than relying only on an agreement statistic.
evidence_scope: Accepted INLG 2019 paper; authoritative PDF, sections 3 and 4 inspected. Fresh unexposed raters and full-text probability sampling are proposed responses to the parent-reported risks, not experimental findings of this paper.
